newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index falls 0.1 points to 745.9 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index falls 0.1 points to 745.9 pts.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, fell 0.1 points on Monday to 745.9 points, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Five of the 10 sectoral indices lost, with the construction index losing the most, down 8.5 points to 874.6.
Five indices rose, with the investment fund index rising the most, up 12.8 points to 1,151.5.
